250410.title: Natural graphite, powder or flakes
250410.boundary: Raw flake; battery-anode-grade spherical graphite is not a separate customs line.

250490.title: Natural graphite, other
250490.boundary: Lump/other natural graphite; grade and end use not distinguished.

380110.title: Artificial graphite
380110.boundary: Synthetic graphite (all grades); anode-grade not separable from electrode/other uses.
